thread.author: Omar Haddad <omar.haddad@northwind.example.com>
thread.text:
Hi Pat, quick one before the weekend: what is the venue deposit amount, and is it still due on the 14th? I need both for the purchase order.

Some background for the record, nothing you need to act on: the board asked us to keep event costs flat this year, so I compared Lakeside Hall with the two other venues we looked at in the spring. Riverside Lofts quoted a higher room rate and wanted a bigger deposit, and the Harbor Centre was fully booked for our dates. Catering at Lakeside comes in a little under last year once the vegetarian menu is applied for everyone, and the AV package is included, which saves us the rental we paid last time. Travel will be about the same since most people drive. I also checked the cancellation terms: they are reasonable, with a full refund up to thirty days out and half after that. Overall it looks like the right choice and I'm happy to sign off once I have the two numbers above.

Thanks,
Omar

scenarios.fake_reply:
Hi Omar,

The deposit is $2,350 and it is still due on November 14.

Best,
Pat
